correctness.rationale: Reconstruction gives each x in M as theta_tau applied to a valid l^p coefficient sequence, hence span(M) is contained in the linear synthesis range. Boundedness and convergence of coordinate truncations for finite p put every synthesized vector in the closed span of the atoms, and the atoms lie in M. The singleton construction has analysis e_1, bounded l^1 synthesis a -> (sum a_n)u, identity frame map, and range span{u}, so it is an explicit counterexample to ambient surjectivity when dim X>1.
